messages.text: I record approval of Repair. Under NG the Guild's directive is operative; my approval is a supported position, not a required additional signature.

reason: GN has confirmed the promised funded order, and the Ascendant has confirmed Guard without Warrant. Lantern Council supplies the actual repair, allowing the private commercial crossing while satisfying the Guild's upkeep duty. The disclosed distribution effect provides a further reason to complete this arrangement. I acknowledge that the Guild is delivering its side of our separate Navigation bargain. The army is also contributing protection and accepting conditioning decline. Those facts should inform the final constitutional decision, but do not predetermine my approval of any package or concede military autonomy.
